note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each one names its sources. Where no reliable method is published yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

official.name: Official trophy list as PlayStation publishes it (names, descriptions, grades, via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

keengamer.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, All 55 Trophies

outputlag.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops with the last of them. There are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no DLC required, and one playthrough is enough. The whole run is long rather than hard: about 200 hours at a 4/10 difficulty, according to PowerPyx. The only thing to do early is the one possibly missable meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as insurance, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first main mission of the game, so this pops early and cannot be missed — just play the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy pops as the chapter closes and the story moves on. Story trophies cannot be missed, so there is nothing to prepare for this one.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It pops as the chapter closes. By this point both Jason and Lucia are playable together, which opens up most of the free-roam trophies — see Hot Together and the roadmap.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops as the chapter closes. Chapter 3 is where several side-character questlines open (Andy, Randy, Tyrone, Yasmani's jobs), so pick those up as they appear rather than leaving them all for later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops as the chapter closes. Before the final mission, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, and a save at the end of each chapter is the safety net PowerPyx recommends for the whole run.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It pops with the credits. After the story you return to free-roam in Leonida, and everything needed for the 100% checklist is still available — nothing on that checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It pops when the mission ends. Automatic and unmissable, like every story-mission trophy.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It pops when the mission ends. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It pops when the mission ends. Automatic and unmissable — and a good preview of the airport for Catch Me If You Can later.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It pops when the mission ends. Automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Finish the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once it unlocks after the story. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. The requirements are lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion: any 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, all robberies (39 gang operations, 8 bank vaults), all 15 Target Decks, and any 100 optional missions. Most of it falls out of the other trophies, so leave this for Stage 2 and check the list only when the story is done.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps (ramps), 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like, and PowerPyx notes the under-bridge ones are the quickest. The 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each stunt has its own name and stays marked once done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your counts under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You meet most of them naturally from the story and the other trophies, and activity spots are marked with blue icons on the map — do not leave this to the end, just sample each one as you find it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. PowerPyx reports the gold medals are not too difficult. Work through them range by range in Stage 2; shooting-range play also raises your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total, so you only need one win per location. Learn each course's turns first, then race for the win; a win at a location counts even if you lose the other races there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each of the 40 unique race locations counts once, so repeat wins at the same spot do not help. Pick the shortest, easiest courses first and work through the list; race wins also count toward the activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.when: After Chapter 1 mission: Feng Shui (meet Cal)
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing itself is one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home using the controllers, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must finish all the levels of one game at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge in it. Pick whichever you enjoy most; it is available from Chapter 1, though home access is briefly unavailable during some story sections and returns after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia and opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van), and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). The quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush — but do them as Lucia, since Jason cannot start them.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It opens in Chapter 1 — after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; find the underwater treasures (use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor) and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared, in sets — after each set he calls you back for more. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so this is not missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all 5 quests: Thrillbillies (check out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Warning: not every side questline counts — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. The strands confirmed to count so far are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother), and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile, Pete's Deliveries). PowerPyx notes more qualifying strangers are still being found, so check the in-game trophy tracker (it shows how many you have completed) and the guide's sources for updates before assuming a strand counts. All of them are still there after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.when: After Chapter 3 mission: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List questline. It opens during the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner — that car counts as the first delivery. He then wants 16 sports cars in total. Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some in fixed locations and more as you complete them, and scanning a car with the WAiNK app tells you if it is wanted. High-end sports cars are common in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. Deliver each car to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) in good condition for better pay. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.when: After Chapter 3 mission: Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason only)
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is only available as Jason and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (shut down the labs), which unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you can track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME: the first meditation only happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. It becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. Whether it is actually required for the trophy is still unconfirmed (it raises the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest), but PowerPyx earned the trophy after doing it, so do it to be safe. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this cannot cost you A Long Road. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.when: After Chapter 2 mission: Coffee Break (Jason only)
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline. It is exclusive to Jason: after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break he texts you, marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted (meet Bret), in Lummox County. His quests ask you to hunt specific animals and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation — one clean shot leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck; all 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally. Which exact animal pops this trophy is still being confirmed, so follow Bret's quests through rather than hunting at random.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across the world; PowerPyx lists 18 card-set locations in its collectible guide. Pick the three sets whose cards you have already found most of, and use the map and your Collections progress to see which sets are closest to complete — you do not need every set, only three.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Hold Up and then R1 to scan objects in the environment — there are more than 100 to find, and any 100 count: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus tags. Start scanning everything unfamiliar from Chapter 1 and this finishes on its own; the same app is how you scan vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. There are 8 categories of 10 (from Combat to Vehicle), and you only need 50 for this trophy — the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges (a checkmark shows when one is completed). Many complete naturally while you work on other trophies; save the hardest ones for last and skip them, since 10 more than needed exist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves. PowerPyx's easiest route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also comes naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank-vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while staying wanted the whole time — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, and do not let it drop to the red heat level or clear. Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), wear an armored vest, and carry sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) plus Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. Loot a couple of items in each shop, ideally going into the back room and breaking the safe with sticky bombs. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not come, hit a fourth shop and keep going. If you leave the first store before police arrive, you may need a fourth shop anyway.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. The game has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), so stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this pops well before that is done. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. Prepare first — buff focus with food and drinks or by washing your face/showering at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Line up 5 enemies, for example at a gang operation, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556 assault rifle rather than a pistol. PowerPyx reports it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. It gets easier as your Focus level rises (4 levels; check under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); raise Focus via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and you may well earn this naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at one of the departure terminals at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly away. It must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge — the planes parked on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge (a door leads straight inside; you can also walk in through the terminal). Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is slightly delayed until you are that far out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, get into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.when: After Chapter 3 mission: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies (green icons on the map in unfogged areas). Enter through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. Inside, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe with the code. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.when: After Chapter 4 optional mission: That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry a briefcase of cash in and open the vault, then go in quickly and rob it. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold Right to hand off a bag. Afterwards, pay Yasmani (unlocked as a fence in Chapter 3; finish his Payday Loans quests first) $10,000 for security-van tips, which mark vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: 5 for this trophy, all 8 for the 100% checklist, paying up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.when: After Chapter 4 optional mission: That's Where The Money Is… (or earlier, free-roam)
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The simplest way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal (That's Where The Money Is…): robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. To get it earlier, watch for armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — the trophy pops only after you escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (Yasmani becomes a fence in Chapter 3). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist, so this also comes automatically in Stage 2.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map, all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. Exploring as you play also feeds the meditation spots, WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries, so do not treat this as a separate chore until the end.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.count: 1 operation for each of 9 gangs (39 total)
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; for this trophy one per gang is enough, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: WHAT IS KNOWN: the official description is the only confirmed hint — enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. WHAT IS NOT YET CONFIRMED: no published guide has pinned down the exact trigger at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and GTABase and Output Lag agree the exact steps are unconfirmed. What to try: go to Ocean Beach in free-roam and look for a bar or venue with a view over the beach, and order a cocktail there. If it does not pop, do not assume a specific bar or drink — the trigger may be a particular spot or moment the guides have not confirmed yet. Check the sources linked here for updates rather than grinding blindly.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.when: After Chapter 3 mission: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and the trophy pops shortly after you drive away down the street. It only works with this blue Banshee, not any other car — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. Source note: PowerPyx reports this method; Output Lag still lists the trophy as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop, re-check the sources before retrying.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.when: Chapter 2 optional mission: Hit Kingpin Bowling (or later)
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations, run by Kolt & Associates. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first: you need them to blow the safe. The three valuables are the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, but it is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can return for the remaining valuables.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check each character's strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on Map > Activities), and always go together with your partner (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it helps to turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever something affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing many cops and civilians, driving over gravestones), and Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since police then shoot on sight more often. This comes passively from robberies and fights while you work on the other trophies; if it is still short at the end, PowerPyx suggests farming it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: WHAT IS KNOWN: the official description reads 'Second time's the charm.' WHAT IS NOT YET CONFIRMED: no published guide has a verified method at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; GTABase and KeenGamer likewise list the exact steps as unconfirmed. The wording suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but that is a reading of the description, not a confirmed trigger — do not grind a guess. This is a cleanup trophy: finish the rest of the list first, then check the sources linked here for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so be patient. Source note: this method is from PowerPyx; other lists still mark the trophy unconfirmed, so treat it as the best current report rather than settled fact.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: WHAT IS KNOWN: the official description reads 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.' WHAT IS NOT YET CONFIRMED: no published guide has a verified method at launch. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; GTABase describes it the same way — knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — and likewise says the exact steps are not confirmed yet. What to try: melee kicks from a moving motorcycle at enemies or pedestrians. If that does not pop it, the trigger is something more specific that the guides have not pinned down — check the sources linked here rather than assuming.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.when: After Chapter 3 mission: Credit Check (meet Raul's crew)
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — the total is cumulative, you do not need $250,000 at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. This comes naturally from the robbery trophies: a single bank vault pays up to $205,000, and vaults only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. It counts across every shop type, and the fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The world has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — buy what you actually want for the other trophies and this total climbs on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.when: After Chapter 2 mission: Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses)
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more garages tied to the story, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — are the quick way to fund them. Garages also add parking spots, which you need for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.when: After Chapter 2 mission: Moses (take a vehicle to Moses)
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
